events.title: Per My Last Email demo: recorded gameplay
events.summary: A recorded run through the free Per My Last Email demo plays here at set hours during Steam Next Fest, taking turns with our other demos. It is not live, so a question in chat may wait a while. The demo is free on this page.

events.title: Every reply is two decisions, and the second one is the real one
events.summary: Hello — this is the first word from us on this page. PER MY LAST EMAIL is an email thriller told entirely through one work laptop. Ten business days at Bellwether & Locke. No faces, no offices, no streets — only what renders on the screen in front of you. You are the newest hire on floor six. Your account is not a new account. It has a sent folder. It has drafts.
